source.acceptance_criteria: Shims are removed or reduced; registry imports direct implementations; extension registration tests pass.
source.description:
PROBLEM: packages/pi-extensions/src/extensions/*.ts are mostly 3-line re-export shims that only import ../extensions/<name>/index.ts and re-export default. The registry can import extension indexes directly.
SCOPE: Update packages/pi-extensions/src/registry.ts to import extension implementations directly, then delete redundant shim files where safe.
GITNEXUS_EVIDENCE: registerManagedPiExtensions impact is LOW: one direct caller registerXtrmPiExtensions. The registry is the central seam to update.
SUCCESS: Same managedPiExtensions list, fewer files, no runtime behavior change.
NON_GOALS: Do not change extension IDs or registration order.
VALIDATION: npm run verify:runtime --workspace @jaggerxtrm/pi-extensions if available; npm run build; extension parity tests.
source.title: Ponytail cleanup: collapse Pi extension shim files

source.acceptance_criteria: cli/pnpm-lock.yaml is removed or documented as required; cli/package-lock.json remains unless CI is changed in the same PR.
source.description:
PROBLEM: cli/pnpm-lock.yaml appears to be a side-effect artifact while the repository CI uses npm. Keeping multiple lock systems creates confusion and extra review churn.
SCOPE: Remove cli/pnpm-lock.yaml if no maintained workflow needs pnpm; document npm as the lock authority for the CLI workspace.
GITNEXUS_EVIDENCE: Repo search found CI using npm ci and no live workflow reference to pnpm-lock. Previous audit marked cli/package-lock.json unsafe to delete because CI runs cd cli && npm ci.
SUCCESS: pnpm lockfile is gone or explicitly justified, and npm CI remains unchanged.
NON_GOALS: Do not remove cli/package-lock.json unless CI is migrated away from cd cli && npm ci.
VALIDATION: .github/workflows/ci.yml still works conceptually; npm ci && cd cli && npm ci; npm test --workspace cli.
source.title: Ponytail cleanup: remove unused pnpm lockfile without breaking npm CI

source.acceptance_criteria: .xtrm/ext-src no longer ships as source; remaining references are intentional docs/migration metadata; Pi runtime tests pass.
source.description:
PROBLEM: .xtrm/ext-src is documented as deprecated legacy Pi extension source, but the files remain tracked alongside the current packages/pi-extensions source. Keeping both invites stale edits and noisy payloads.
SCOPE: Remove tracked .xtrm/ext-src files, preserve/update migration documentation, and decide whether legacy-path-map should remain as documentation-only compatibility metadata.
GITNEXUS_EVIDENCE: Live references were limited to docs/xtrm-directory.md and packages/pi-extensions/src/shared/legacy-path-map.ts; current runtime functions resolve packages/pi-extensions.
SUCCESS: Deprecated source files are gone while legacy cleanup/docs still explain the migration path.
NON_GOALS: Do not remove packages/pi-extensions or break existing installed user extensions.
VALIDATION: npm run check:layout-guards; npm run check:payload-hygiene; Pi runtime/source-dir tests.
source.title: Ponytail cleanup: retire deprecated .xtrm/ext-src extension tree

source.acceptance_criteria: .xtrm/skills/deferred is removed/migrated or officially supported with tests/docs.
source.description:
PROBLEM: .xtrm/skills/deferred contains skills outside the documented default/optional/user/active tier model. There is little code support for a deferred tier, so it is either dead inventory or undocumented policy.
SCOPE: Decide whether deferred skills should be deleted, moved into optional packs, or documented as a supported tier with tooling.
GITNEXUS_EVIDENCE: Search found no active tier handling for .xtrm/skills/deferred in the skills layout; current tiers are default, optional, and user.
SUCCESS: No unsupported tracked tier remains, or the tier is explicitly supported and tested.
NON_GOALS: Do not silently drop useful skills; preserve by moving to optional if still valuable.
VALIDATION: skill discovery/materializer tests; check-layout-guards; docs update if tier remains.
source.title: Ponytail cleanup: remove or formalize deferred skill tier

source.acceptance_criteria: cli/lib and test-vault-dryrun.js are removed; no import references remain; CLI build/tests pass.
source.description:
PROBLEM: cli/lib contains an old JavaScript copy of CLI internals preserved after TypeScript migration, plus test-vault-dryrun.js imports that old tree. This duplicates logic that should live in cli/src and cli/dist only.
SCOPE: Remove cli/lib and test-vault-dryrun.js after confirming no shipped command, test, or doc path depends on them.
GITNEXUS_EVIDENCE: GitNexus shows cli/lib symbols have little/no upstream impact; CHANGELOG says old cli/lib/*.js was preserved but no longer referenced. Text refs are mostly docs and the stale dry-run script.
SUCCESS: Old JS mirror is gone and TypeScript source/build remains the only implementation.
NON_GOALS: Do not remove cli/dist, because package bin points to compiled output.
VALIDATION: npm run typecheck --workspace cli; npm test --workspace cli; npm run build; git diff --exit-code cli/dist/ after build if required.
source.title: Ponytail cleanup: remove old JS CLI mirror and dry-run script

source.acceptance_criteria: Unused deps are absent from manifest/lockfiles and all CLI checks pass.
source.description:
PROBLEM: cli/package.json lists runtime dependencies listr2, minimist, and project, but exact import scans found no usage. Unused dependencies increase install size and audit noise.
SCOPE: Remove unused dependency declarations and update lockfiles using the repository-supported package manager flow.
GITNEXUS_EVIDENCE: Exact import search found no imports/requires for listr2, minimist, or project in cli/src, scripts, packages, or extension sources.
SUCCESS: Dependencies are removed, lockfiles are consistent, and CLI build/tests pass.
NON_GOALS: Do not replace dependencies that are actively imported.
VALIDATION: npm install or npm ci-equivalent lock refresh; npm run typecheck --workspace cli; npm test --workspace cli; npm run build.
source.title: Ponytail cleanup: remove unused CLI dependencies

source.acceptance_criteria: A single canonical skill source is implemented or a documented decision keeps both; all skill runtime/release gates pass.
source.description:
PROBLEM: The repo has both root skills/ and .xtrm/skills/default with overlapping content. This is the largest line-saving candidate but also touches source-root discovery and runtime skill materialization.
SCOPE: Decide the canonical source for built-in skills, update findRepoRoot/source repo detection, registry generation, materialization, docs, and release gates accordingly.
GITNEXUS_EVIDENCE: findRepoRoot impact CRITICAL: direct callers include claude, clean, init preflight, install-pi, pi, spec apply/doctor, and status. discoverDefaultSkills and rebuildAllRuntimeActiveViews are also CRITICAL.
SUCCESS: One canonical skill source remains, active runtime views still build, package payload still includes required skills, and user fallback remains intact.
NON_GOALS: Do not delete either tree before proving package/install/runtime behavior end-to-end.
VALIDATION: npm run gen-registry; npm run check:registry-pack-parity; npm run check:skills-ownership; npm run check:layout-guards; skills materializer/discovery tests; xt init smoke.
source.title: Ponytail cleanup: resolve root skills vs .xtrm/skills/default source split

source.acceptance_criteria: Decision recorded; if replaced, fs-extra is gone from manifests and all CLI tests/build pass.
source.description:
PROBLEM: fs-extra is heavily used for file operations that modern node:fs/promises can cover. Removing it could cut a dependency, but the churn is broad and easy to get subtly wrong.
SCOPE: Inventory fs-extra usage and replace only low-risk calls where Node stdlib is equivalent, or document why keeping fs-extra is cheaper.
GITNEXUS_EVIDENCE: Import scan found fs-extra used in roughly 98 files including tests and core CLI utilities. Previous audit verdict: not worth doing as casual cleanup.
SUCCESS: Either dependency remains with justification, or a staged mechanical migration removes it with strong test coverage.
NON_GOALS: Do not mix this with functional cleanup epics.
VALIDATION: full CLI test suite; build; install/init smoke; Windows path semantics review for copy/remove/ensureDir equivalents.
source.title: Ponytail cleanup: reassess fs-extra dependency replacement

source.acceptance_criteria: One parent epic owns all Ponytail cleanup child tasks; every child has risk-specific validation evidence before close.
source.description:
PROBLEM: Ponytail audit identified roughly 51k lines of possible cleanup, but GitNexus showed mixed risk: some candidates are safe deletions, while skills/runtime source cleanup is HIGH/CRITICAL risk. The work should be tracked as one cleanup epic with child tasks, not many independent epics.
SCOPE: Coordinate the vetted cleanup candidates as child issues, preserving GitNexus risk evidence and requiring targeted validation per child.
SUCCESS: Each cleanup candidate is implemented or explicitly rejected with evidence; no init/status/preflight/Pi-runtime/skills-runtime regression ships.
NON_GOALS: Do not batch all deletions into one PR; high-risk children must be handled separately.
VALIDATION: Child-specific validation plus final npm test --workspace cli, npm run build, and GitNexus detect-changes before merge.
source.title: Ponytail cleanup: repository line-count reduction

source.acceptance_criteria: .xtrm/cache/docs-list.json is untracked/ignored and docs commands still work.
source.description:
PROBLEM: .xtrm/cache/docs-list.json is generated by docs-cache code and should not be source-controlled unless it is an intentional package artifact. Tracking cache creates noisy diffs.
SCOPE: Remove the cache file from git, ensure .gitignore/package rules exclude generated cache, and keep docs list command regenerating it.
GITNEXUS_EVIDENCE: docs-cache.ts writes .xtrm/cache/docs-list.json at runtime. References are confined to docs scanner/list tests and docs command behavior.
SUCCESS: Cache regenerates locally but is not tracked.
NON_GOALS: Do not remove docs scanning functionality.
VALIDATION: docs-list tests; xtrm docs list smoke; git status stays clean after cache generation if ignored.
source.title: Ponytail cleanup: stop tracking generated docs cache

source.acceptance_criteria: .xtrm/packages/pi-extensions is untracked/removed; no runtime or packaging reference expects it; Pi extension package tests pass.
source.description:
PROBLEM: The repository keeps a tracked duplicate of the Pi extension package under .xtrm/packages/pi-extensions even though packages/pi-extensions is the documented source of truth. This adds thousands of mirrored lines and increases drift risk without serving a runtime path.
SCOPE: Remove .xtrm/packages/pi-extensions from tracked payload, update any stale registry/package references, and keep packages/pi-extensions as the only package source.
GITNEXUS_EVIDENCE: Text search found no live references to .xtrm/packages. GitNexus Pi-extension flows point at packages/pi-extensions/package-mode runtime, not the .xtrm/packages mirror.
SUCCESS: The mirror is gone from git, package/install flows still resolve npm:@jaggerxtrm/pi-extensions, and registry/package parity checks pass.
NON_GOALS: Do not change extension behavior or package publishing semantics.
VALIDATION: npm run check:registry-pack-parity; npm run check:payload-hygiene; npm run build; targeted Pi runtime tests.
source.title: Ponytail cleanup: remove duplicate Pi extension package mirror

source.acceptance_criteria: Either legacy branch is removed with tests, or issue documents why it must remain; no init/status/preflight regression.
source.description:
PROBLEM: calculateDiff/detectAdapter still carry legacy .agents/skills and single-Claude adapter plumbing. This looks like stale compatibility code, but it sits in init/status/preflight paths.
SCOPE: Investigate and, if safe, remove the .agents/skills special-case and ToolAdapter/ClaudeAdapter abstraction in favor of direct current .xtrm/skills runtime logic.
GITNEXUS_EVIDENCE: calculateDiff risk HIGH: direct callers runPreflight in init/core and createStatusCommand. detectAdapter risk HIGH via calculateDiff. Affected processes include runProjectInit, createStatusCommand, and runPreflight.
SUCCESS: Legacy branch removed only after compatibility decision and tests prove init/status/preflight unchanged for supported installs.
NON_GOALS: Do not remove deprecated user cleanup/migration reporting unless replacement exists.
VALIDATION: npm test --workspace cli; init/status/preflight integration tests; run xt init/status smoke in temp project.
source.title: Ponytail cleanup: retire legacy adapter/diff .agents skills branch safely

source.acceptance_criteria: ConfigAdapter indirection is reduced without changing hook script command output or sync behavior.
source.description:
PROBLEM: ConfigAdapter remains as a Claude-only abstraction after multi-agent hook translation was removed. It may be needless indirection, but it still owns hook command path resolution in sync-executor.
SCOPE: Either inline the small Claude-only hook adaptation into sync-executor or rename/simplify the class to reflect its actual purpose.
GITNEXUS_EVIDENCE: ConfigAdapter impact is LOW: direct callers are executeSync and sync-executor import. Affected process is executeSync.
SUCCESS: Same hooks.json adaptation behavior with less abstraction.
NON_GOALS: Do not reintroduce Gemini/Qwen adapter translation.
VALIDATION: hook/sync tests, install dry-run/status paths, npm test --workspace cli.
source.title: Ponytail cleanup: simplify ConfigAdapter only within sync-executor seam
